column1: # Round-3 2 Mb arms: the ONE mapping between the two naming schemes.
#   column 1  arm name used in simulation_data/ and in the archive on /n/data2
#   column 2  workdir suffix on O2 scratch (simulations_round_3_2Mb_<suffix>)
#   column 3  human-readable description of the experimental condition
# The two names encode the same settings in different dialects and NEITHER can be
#   local   cmaf<digits> / fm<digits>   digits after an implied "0." -- so cmaf01
#           is 0.01, cmaf001 is 0.001, cmaf0 is 0. This is what
#   O2      cmaf_<value> / fm_<value>   the literal value, and the `_fm_<value>`
#           half is OMITTED on arms that predate the separate fine-mapping floor.
# So `cmaf001_fm01_g5t20_2Mb` <-> `g5t20_cmaf_0.001`: same arm, and the fm floor is
# stated on one side and implied on the other. Getting this wrong silently pairs
# two different experimental conditions, which is why it lives in one file that
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
